data.name: FileFluss is a dual‑panel file manager for macOS that lets you work with local folders and multiple cloud storage accounts side by side. It is built around a left and right panel — copy, move, sync, and compare files between them with a few clicks.
data.value: FileFluss 是一款適用於 Windows 的雙面板檔案管理程式，可讓你並排處理本機資料夾和多個雲端儲存帳戶。它圍繞左右兩個面板建構——只需按幾下，即可在兩者之間複製、移動、同步和比較檔案。

data.name: **Two independent panels**, each can show a local folder or a connected cloud account.
data.value: **兩個獨立的面板**，每個都可顯示本機資料夾或已連接的雲端帳戶。

data.name: **Drag & drop** between panels to copy or move files.
data.value: 在面板之間**拖放**以複製或移動檔案。

data.name: **Sync** to make the two sides match (mirror, newer, or additive).
data.value: **同步**以使兩側保持一致（鏡像、較新或附加）。

data.name: **Compare** to see which files differ, are missing, or match between the two sides.
data.value: **比較**以查看兩側之間哪些檔案有差異、缺少或一致。

data.name: **Search** across local files and every connected cloud account at once.
data.value: 同時在本機檔案和每個已連接的雲端帳戶中**搜尋**。

data.name: **Refresh** — reload both panels.
data.value: **重新整理**——重新載入兩個面板。

data.name: **Hidden Files** — toggle showing dotfiles in the active panel.
data.value: **隱藏檔案**——在使用中面板裡切換顯示點檔案。

data.name: **Copy Mode** / **Move Mode** — force every drag & drop to that operation.
data.value: **複製模式** / **移動模式**——強制每次拖放都執行該操作。

data.name: Right‑click the toolbar and choose *Customize Toolbar…* to rearrange or hide buttons.
data.value: 將滑鼠指標停留在工具列按鈕上，大多數按鈕都會顯示簡短說明。

data.name: FileFluss shows a left panel and a right panel. The active panel is marked with a thin accent line at the top — most actions (toolbar buttons, keyboard shortcuts, the search target) apply to whichever panel is active.
data.value: FileFluss 顯示一個左面板和一個右面板。使用中面板頂部有一條細的強調線標記——大多數操作（工具列按鈕、鍵盤快捷鍵、搜尋目標）都會作用於目前使用中的面板。

data.name: Click anywhere inside a panel to make it active.
data.value: 點按面板內任意位置即可將其啟用。

data.name: The sidebar of each panel is independent — choose a different favourite, location, or cloud account on each side.
data.value: 每個面板的側邊欄都是獨立的——可在每一側選擇不同的喜好項目、位置或雲端帳戶。

data.name: The breadcrumb at the top of each panel shows the current folder path. Click any segment to navigate up.
data.value: 每個面板頂部的路徑麵包屑顯示目前資料夾路徑。點按任一段即可向上瀏覽。

data.name: You can drop files onto a path‑bar segment to move/copy them into that folder.
data.value: 你也可以將檔案拖放到路徑列的某一段，以將其移動/複製到該資料夾中。

data.name: If you open the same cloud account in both panels (e.g. kDrive on the left and on the right), the two panels behave **independently**: you can browse to different folders on each side and drag between them.
data.value: 如果你在兩個面板中打開同一個雲端帳戶（例如左右都是 kDrive），這兩個面板將**獨立**運作：你可以在每一側瀏覽到不同的資料夾並在它們之間拖動。

data.name: Dragging a file from the same cloud account on the left to a folder on the right does an **in‑cloud** move/copy — the data stays on the server, no re‑upload.
data.value: 將左側同一雲端帳戶中的檔案拖到右側的某個資料夾，會執行**雲端內**移動/複製——資料保留在伺服器上，無需重新上傳。

data.name: Cloud accounts are connected once and then appear in the sidebar of both panels.
data.value: 雲端帳戶只需連接一次，隨後會出現在兩個面板的側邊欄中。

data.name: Open **Settings → Cloud Accounts** (⌘,).
data.value: 開啟 **設定 → 雲端帳戶**（Ctrl+,）。

data.name: Click **Add Cloud Account** and pick the provider (kDrive, pCloud, OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, MEGA, Koofr, NextCloud, WebDAV, SFTP, GMX Cloud, WordPress, …).
data.value: 點按 **加入雲端帳戶** 並選擇服務商（kDrive、pCloud、OneDrive、Google Drive、Dropbox、MEGA、Koofr、NextCloud、WebDAV、SFTP、GMX Cloud、WordPress……）。

data.name: Sign in via the provider's authentication flow. FileFluss stores the tokens securely in your macOS Keychain.
data.value: 透過服務商的驗證流程登入。FileFluss 會將權杖儲存在 Windows 認證存放區中，並針對你的 Windows 使用者帳戶加密。

data.name: The new account immediately appears in both panels' sidebars.
data.value: 新帳戶會立即出現在兩個面板的側邊欄中。

data.name: Click the account in either sidebar to load it in that panel.
data.value: 在任一側邊欄中點按該帳戶，即可在該面板中載入它。

data.name: Navigate folders the same way as local — double‑click to enter, or click breadcrumbs to go back up.
data.value: 像瀏覽本機一樣瀏覽資料夾——點兩下進入，或點按麵包屑返回上層。

data.name: In **Settings → Cloud Accounts**, click the trash icon next to the account.
data.value: 在 **設定 → 雲端帳戶** 中，按一下帳戶旁邊的 **移除**。

data.name: FileFluss disconnects the account, removes the cached login, and clears its panels.
data.value: FileFluss 會中斷該帳戶連接、移除快取的登入資訊並清空其面板。

data.name: Some providers expose a sandboxed root (e.g. WordPress' media library). Behaviour like *create folder* may be unavailable for those providers — FileFluss greys out the actions that don't apply.
data.value: 某些服務商提供沙盒化的根目錄（例如 WordPress 的媒體庫）。對這些服務商，*新增資料夾* 等行為可能無法使用——FileFluss 會將不適用的操作變灰。

data.name: There are several ways to move or copy files between the two panels:
data.value: 在兩個面板之間移動或複製檔案有多種方式：

data.name: Drag selected files from one panel and drop them on the other.
data.value: 從一個面板拖動所選檔案並放到另一個面板上。

data.name: By default a prompt appears asking *Move or Copy?*.
data.value: 預設情況下會出現一個詢問 *移動還是複製？* 的提示。

data.name: Drop directly onto a folder row to land inside that folder, or onto the table background to drop into the panel's current directory.
data.value: 直接放到某個資料夾列上即可放入該資料夾，或放到表格背景上即可放入面板的目前目錄。

data.name: You can also drop onto a breadcrumb in the path bar to land in that ancestor folder.
data.value: 你也可以放到路徑列的某個麵包屑上，以放入該上層資料夾。

data.name: Select files, right‑click, and choose **Copy to Other Panel** or **Move to Other Panel**.
data.value: 選擇檔案，按右鍵，然後選擇 **複製到另一面板** 或 **移動到另一面板**。

data.name: Same effect as drag & drop, but no prompt — the action is taken immediately.
data.value: 效果與拖放相同，但沒有提示——操作會立即執行。

data.name: If a file with the same name already exists at the destination, FileFluss asks how to resolve the conflict (replace, keep both, skip).
data.value: 如果目標位置已存在同名檔案，FileFluss 會詢問如何解決衝突（取代、兩者都保留、略過）。

data.name: If you find the *Move or Copy?* prompt repetitive, enable **Copy Mode** or **Move Mode** in the toolbar — see the next section.
data.value: 如果你覺得 *移動還是複製？* 提示太頻繁，可在工具列中啟用 **複製模式** 或 **移動模式**——見下一節。

data.name: **Copy Mode** and **Move Mode** are two toolbar toggles that change how every drag & drop is interpreted.
data.value: **複製模式** 和 **移動模式** 是工具列中的兩個開關，用於改變每次拖放的解釋方式。

data.name: When active, every drop is automatically a **copy** — the *Move or Copy?* prompt is skipped.
data.value: 啟用後，每次放下都會自動執行**複製**——會略過 *移動還是複製？* 提示。

data.name: Useful when you're duplicating a lot of files between folders or panels.
data.value: 在資料夾或面板之間複製大量檔案時很有用。

data.name: When active, every drop is automatically a **move** — files are removed from the source.
data.value: 啟用後，每次放下都會自動執行**移動**——檔案會從來源中移除。

data.name: Useful when re‑organising a folder.
data.value: 重新整理資料夾時很有用。

data.name: The two toggles are **mutually exclusive** — turning one on turns the other off.
data.value: 這兩個開關**互斥**——開啟其中一個會關閉另一個。

data.name: Both reset to off when FileFluss relaunches, so a stuck *Move Mode* can't silently destroy files across sessions.
data.value: 兩者都會在 FileFluss 重新啟動時重置為關閉，因此卡住的 *移動模式* 不會在多次工作階段中悄悄破壞檔案。

data.name: When neither mode is on, FileFluss falls back to the standard *Move or Copy?* prompt.
data.value: 當兩種模式都未開啟時，FileFluss 會回到標準的 *移動還是複製？* 提示。

data.name: **Sync** makes the destination folder match the source folder according to the rule you choose. Use it for one‑shot replications between local and cloud, or between two cloud accounts.
data.value: **同步** 會根據你選擇的規則使目標資料夾與來源資料夾一致。可用於本機與雲端、或兩個雲端帳戶之間的一次性複製。

data.name: Open one folder on the left and one on the right.
data.value: 在左側打開一個資料夾，在右側打開一個資料夾。

data.name: Choose the **direction** (Left → Right or Right → Left).
data.value: 選擇**方向**（左 → 右 或 右 → 左）。

data.name: FileFluss enumerates both sides and shows a plan: how many files will be added, replaced, deleted, and how many bytes will be transferred. Click **Start Sync**.
data.value: FileFluss 會列舉兩側並顯示一個計畫：將加入、取代、刪除多少檔案，以及將傳輸多少位元組。點按 **開始同步**。

data.name: **Newer** — copy files from the source whose modification date is newer than the destination's. Existing files only get replaced if they're truly newer.
data.value: **較新**——從來源複製修改日期比目標更新的檔案。僅當檔案確實更新時才會取代現有檔案。

data.name: **Mirror** — make the destination an exact copy of the source. **Files at the destination that are not on the source are deleted.** This is destructive — FileFluss requires explicit confirmation.
data.value: **鏡像**——使目標成為來源的精確副本。**目標中不存在於來源的檔案將被刪除。** 此操作具破壞性——FileFluss 需要明確確認。

data.name: **Additive** — only copy files that are missing on the destination. If a file already exists, the source is added next to it with a unique name. Nothing is overwritten or deleted.
data.value: **附加**——僅複製目標中缺少的檔案。如果檔案已存在，會以唯一名稱將來源加到其旁邊。不會覆寫或刪除任何內容。

data.name: During sync, if a file with the same name exists on both sides but neither mode handles it cleanly, FileFluss asks per‑file how to resolve.
data.value: 在同步過程中，如果兩側都存在同名檔案，但沒有任何模式能乾淨地處理它，FileFluss 會逐一檔案詢問如何解決。

data.name: Sync runs in the background — you can keep working in either panel while it transfers. Progress shows in the destination panel's sidebar; click it to see details.
data.value: 同步在背景執行——傳輸期間你可以繼續在任一面板中工作。進度顯示在目標面板的側邊欄中；點按即可查看詳細資訊。

data.name: **Compare** shows you the differences between the two panels' folders without changing anything.
data.value: **比較** 會在不更改任何內容的情況下向你顯示兩個面板資料夾之間的差異。

data.name: FileFluss enumerates both sides recursively and opens a window with the result.
data.value: FileFluss 會遞迴列舉兩側，並打開一個顯示結果的視窗。

data.name: **Different** (red ⚠) — file exists on both sides but its size (or modification date, if enabled) differs.
data.value: **不同**（紅色 ⚠）——檔案在兩側都存在，但其大小（或修改日期，若啟用）不同。

data.name: **Only on Left** (← blue) — file exists only in the left folder.
data.value: **僅左側**（← 藍色）——檔案僅存在於左側資料夾中。

data.name: **Only on Right** (→ orange) — file exists only in the right folder.
data.value: **僅右側**（→ 橙色）——檔案僅存在於右側資料夾中。

data.name: **Identical** (✓ green) — file matches on both sides.
data.value: **相同**（✓ 綠色）——檔案在兩側一致。

data.name: Folders are **collapsible** — click the disclosure arrow to expand and see what's inside. The folder header shows aggregate counts for the active filter.
data.value: 資料夾**可摺疊**——點按展開三角形即可展開並查看其中內容。資料夾標題會顯示目前篩選條件的彙總計數。

data.name: Use the **filter chips** at the top to narrow to one status, e.g. show only differences.
data.value: 使用頂部的**篩選標籤**以縮小到某一狀態，例如僅顯示差異。

data.name: Off by default — only file size is compared.
data.value: 預設關閉——僅比較檔案大小。

data.name: When on, files with the same size but a different modification date count as **Different**, and each row shows both modify and create timestamps along with a *Left newer* / *Right newer* badge.
data.value: 啟用後，大小相同但修改日期不同的檔案會計為**不同**，並且每一列都會顯示修改和建立時間戳記以及 *左側較新* / *右側較新* 標記。

data.name: The comparison only re‑runs when you click **Compare** in the toolbar or **Compare Again** in the window — browsing folders while the window is open does not trigger a fresh scan.
data.value: 僅當你點按工具列中的 **比較** 或視窗中的 **再次比較** 時，比較才會重新執行——在視窗打開時瀏覽資料夾不會觸發新的掃描。

data.name: The compare window stays open and is **movable** — drag it aside to see both panels behind it.
data.value: 比較視窗會保持打開且**可移動**——將它拖到一旁即可看到後面的兩個面板。

data.name: **Search** queries the active local panel and every connected cloud account simultaneously.
data.value: **搜尋** 會同時查詢使用中的本機面板和每個已連接的雲端帳戶。

data.name: Click **Search** in the toolbar, or press **⌘F**.
data.value: 按一下工具列中的 **搜尋**，或按 **Ctrl+F**。

data.name: Type a query — results stream in as each source responds.
data.value: 輸入查詢——結果會隨著每個來源回應而陸續顯示。

data.name: Filter by source using the chips below the search field.
data.value: 使用搜尋欄下方的標籤依來源進行篩選。

data.name: **Double‑click** a result to load its parent folder in the active panel.
data.value: **點兩下** 某個結果可在使用中面板裡載入其父資料夾。

data.name: **Right‑click** to choose **Open in Left Panel** or **Open in Right Panel** explicitly.
data.value: **按右鍵** 可明確選擇 **在左面板中打開** 或 **在右面板中打開**。

data.name: The search window stays open after picking a result, so you can pick more.
data.value: 選擇某個結果後，搜尋視窗會保持打開，以便你繼續選擇更多。

data.name: Click the round X close button, press **Esc**, or click the red traffic‑light button.
data.value: 按一下圓形的 X 關閉按鈕、按 **Esc**，或按一下視窗的關閉按鈕。

data.name: The search window is movable and resizable — its size is remembered across launches.
data.value: 搜尋視窗可移動且可調整大小——其大小會在多次啟動之間被記住。

data.name: Files on local panels and on cloud accounts open the same way.
data.value: 本機面板和雲端帳戶上的檔案以相同方式打開。

data.name: **Double‑click** any file. Word documents open in Word, PDFs in Preview, images in your image viewer, and so on.

data.name: Failed to access the NAS's sharing links.
data.value: 無法存取 NAS 的共用連結。

data.name: The sharing link does not exist.
Could not connect to the server.
Network is unreachable from this PC.
data.value: 無法從這台電腦存取網路。

data.name: the server's certificate could not be verified.
data.value: 無法驗證伺服器的憑證。

data.name: S3 endpoint URL is invalid (host: "{0}"). Double-check the Endpoint URL field.
data.value: S3 端點 URL 無效（主機：「{0}」）。請檢查「端點 URL」欄位。

data.name: This key isn't allowed to list the account's buckets (s3:ListAllMyBuckets). Enter the bucket name in the Path field — FileFluss then works with that bucket alone and won't ask for account-wide permissions.
data.value: 此金鑰無權列出帳戶的值區（s3:ListAllMyBuckets）。請在「路徑」欄位中輸入值區名稱——FileFluss 將只使用該值區，不會要求整個帳戶的權限。

data.name: The downloaded file is corrupted: its MEGA integrity check (MAC) does not match.
data.value: 下載的檔案已損毀：其 MEGA 完整性檢查（MAC）不相符。

data.name: Could not connect — check the host, port, and that FTP is reachable.
data.value: 無法連線——請檢查主機、連接埠，以及 FTP 是否可以存取。

data.name: Could not resolve host. Check the server address.
data.value: 無法解析主機。請檢查伺服器位址。

data.name: Connection refused — is the SSH daemon running on this host and port?
data.value: 連線遭拒——此主機和連接埠上是否正在執行 SSH 服務？

data.name: Connection timed out. Check the hostname, port, and your network.
data.value: 連線逾時。請檢查主機名稱、連接埠和你的網路。

data.name: Could not resolve hostname. Check spelling or DNS.
data.value: 無法解析主機名稱。請檢查拼字或 DNS。

data.name: SSH authentication failed. Check the username and password.
data.value: SSH 驗證失敗。請檢查使用者名稱和密碼。

data.name: SSH authentication failed. The server may not have your public key authorized, or the passphrase is wrong.
data.value: SSH 驗證失敗。伺服器可能未授權你的公開金鑰，或者複雜密碼錯誤。

data.name: SSH key was rejected by the server. Make sure the public key is in the server's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys (or added to the provider's SSH-keys panel for managed services like Hetzner Storage Box).
data.value: 伺服器拒絕了 SSH 金鑰。請確認公開金鑰位於伺服器的 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys 中（若是 Hetzner Storage Box 等代管服務，請將其加入服務商的 SSH 金鑰面板）。

data.name: The private key is protected by a passphrase. Enter it and try again.
data.value: 私密金鑰受複雜密碼保護。請輸入複雜密碼後再試一次。

data.name: Wrong passphrase for the private key.
data.value: 私密金鑰的複雜密碼錯誤。

data.name: Private key is in an unsupported format. Convert it to OpenSSH format (e.g. with `puttygen key.ppk -O private-openssh -o id_rsa`).
data.value: 私密金鑰的格式不受支援。請將其轉換為 OpenSSH 格式（例如使用 `puttygen key.ppk -O private-openssh -o id_rsa`）。

data.name: This SFTP operation is not supported by the bundled SSH library.
data.value: 內建的 SSH 程式庫不支援此 SFTP 操作。

data.name: Host key verification failed — the server's host key changed. If you expected this, edit the account and connect again to accept the new key.
data.value: 主機金鑰驗證失敗——伺服器的主機金鑰已變更。如果這在你的預期之中，請編輯帳戶並重新連線以接受新金鑰。

data.name: Cannot delete a Seafile library from FileFluss. Use the Seafile web UI.
data.value: 無法在 FileFluss 中刪除 Seafile 資料庫。請使用 Seafile 網頁介面。

data.name: Cannot share the Seafile library list — pick a file or folder inside a library.
data.value: 無法共用 Seafile 資料庫清單——請選擇資料庫中的檔案或資料夾。

data.name: Cannot upload directly to the Seafile library root — pick a library first.
data.value: 無法直接上傳到 Seafile 資料庫的根目錄——請先選擇一個資料庫。

data.name: Create a library in the Seafile web UI before adding folders.
data.value: 加入資料夾之前，請先在 Seafile 網頁介面中建立資料庫。

data.name: Rename a Seafile library from its web UI.
data.value: 請在 Seafile 網頁介面中重新命名資料庫。

data.name: This library is encrypted. Unlock it in the Seafile web interface, then try again.
data.value: 此資料庫已加密。請在 Seafile 網頁介面中解鎖後再試一次。

data.name: Filen /v3/auth/info returned an unexpected payload.
data.value: Filen /v3/auth/info 傳回了非預期的資料。

data.name: Filen /v3/user/baseFolder didn't return a root UUID.
Filen account uses auth version {0}. FileFluss currently supports v2 accounts only — Filen v1 / v3 (Argon2) are not yet implemented.
data.value: Filen 帳戶使用驗證版本 {0}。FileFluss 目前僅支援 v2 帳戶——尚未實作 Filen v1 / v3（Argon2）。

data.name: Filen file key isn't 32 ASCII bytes — encrypted with an auth-version we don't support yet.
data.value: Filen 檔案金鑰不是 32 個 ASCII 位元組——它使用了尚不支援的驗證版本加密。

data.name: Filen file metadata not cached — listing didn't populate chunk info.
data.value: Filen 檔案中繼資料未快取——清單未提供區塊資訊。

data.name: Filen file metadata not cached — re-open the folder and try again.
data.value: Filen 檔案中繼資料未快取——請重新開啟資料夾後再試一次。

data.name: Filen login succeeded but the server didn't return an apiKey.
data.value: Filen 登入成功，但伺服器未傳回 apiKey。

data.name: Synology rejected the file path.
data.value: Synology 拒絕了該檔案路徑。

data.name: Synology administrator must enforce 2-factor authentication.
data.value: Synology 系統管理員要求使用雙重驗證。

data.name: No such account or incorrect password.
data.value: 帳戶不存在或密碼錯誤。

data.name: Password expired — please reset it from DSM.
data.value: 密碼已過期——請在 DSM 中重設。

data.name: Password must be changed at first login.
data.value: 首次登入時必須變更密碼。

data.name: This account requires a 2-factor authentication (OTP) code.
data.value: 此帳戶需要雙重驗證（OTP）代碼。

data.name: OTP code authentication has failed too many times.
data.value: OTP 代碼驗證失敗次數過多。

data.name: Maximum number of OTP retries reached. Try again later.
data.value: 已達 OTP 重試次數上限。請稍後再試。

data.name: Invalid API method version.
data.value: 無效的 API 方法版本。
